description: Fixed phrases that read as machine-written: chat residue, a model's talk about itself, staged openers, and stock transitions. `aidd validate` warns on one in a Spec's prose, outside code, quotes, and blockquotes, and `tests/test_plain_language.py` keeps aidd's own pages free of them. Whole phrases only, any case. A warning, never an error. Keep the list short: only a phrase that is almost never the right word in a Spec. The ideas follow the humanizer skills read on 2026-11-05 (blader/humanizer and phuryn/work-humanizer, MIT), restated, never copied.
